interface_detail: the Azure portal, CLI and ARM API; SSH keys set at VM creation
tooling: az CLI, the ARM and Bicep templates, the SDKs
chaining: 12 months of a burstable VM and then a pay-as-you-go bill

limits.value: VM hours are free for 12 months, then billed; the USD 200 credit lasts 30 days
750 hours each of B1s, B2pts v2 and B2ats v2: one of each fits 24/7 for a month

limits_note: a USD 1 authorisation hold is placed at signup and removed
notes: Twelve months is longer than AWS's six and it is still a trial. The 65 or more always-free services on the same page are the durable ones, and the VM hours are not among them.

free_tier.stated: USD 200 of credit for 30 days plus 750 hours each of B1s, B2pts v2 and B2ats v2 burstable VMs for 12 months
free_tier.notes: the VM hours are 12 months for new customers; the credit is 30 days

retention.stated: 12 months for the VM hours; the USD 200 credit expires after 30 days

egress.terms: not part of the free-account terms read; standard egress applies past any allowance

identity_cost.detail: a card and a phone number are required for identity verification, quoted

evidence.proved: 750 hours each of B1s, B2pts v2 (Arm) and B2ats v2 (AMD) burstable VMs for 12 months
a USD 200 credit usable for 30 days; a USD 1 temporary authorisation hold at signup
the phone number and card are used for identity verification to validate that account holders are real people

keep_rate.basis: a running VM bills its hours against the 750

network_out.ports: all through a network security group

binding_note: the 12-month window ends the 750 hours, so the clock is the constraint
